from datasets import load_dataset
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
from collections import Counter

ds = load_dataset("ryanmarten/OpenThoughts-1k-sample", "metadata", split="train")
print(ds)
print(Counter(ds["domain"]))
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct")
sci = ds.filter(lambda x: x["domain"] == "science")
print(len(sci))
tot_r = tot_s = 0
for col, name in (("deepseek_reasoning","r"),("deepseek_solution","s")):
    texts = [t if t is not None else "" for t in sci[col]]
    enc = tok(texts, add_special_tokens=False)["input_ids"]
    n = sum(len(e) for e in enc)
    print(col, n)
    if name=="r": tot_r=n
    else: tot_s=n
print("TOTAL", tot_r+tot_s)
open("/app/answer.txt","w").write(str(tot_r+tot_s))
EOF
python3 count.py
